text:
kai_chen: hey team, quick onboarding snag — I can't access the Sentry project for Runtime (404/403 when I click Projects). Getting redirected to the org page and then a 403. anyone know which group i should be in?
sam_devex: welcome! :tada: you should be in the `obs-read` group for read-only project access, and `obs-edit` for dashboard edits. do you see the 'Request access' button on the project page?
kai_chen: nope, there's no request button. screenshot shows `You do not have permission to access this resource (403)`.
jordan_prodeng: sometimes Okta hasn't synced. @mira_platform can you check if Kai is in the right AD group?
mira_platform: on it. what's Kai's Okta email?
kai_chen: kai.chen@redwood.ai
mira_platform: thanks — I see Kai in `engineers` and `developers` but not in `obs-read`. sending invite now. should propagate in ~5-10m.
onboard-bot: Added kai.chen@redwood.ai to group `obs-read`.
kai_chen: thanks! while I'm here — the Datadog dashboard link in the onboarding doc 404s for me too. is there a canonical team dashboard for Runtime latency + errors?
jordan_prodeng: yes — Runtime -> Runtime Overview. URL is https://app.datadog.com/dashboard/runtime-overview (we use a short alias in docs though). try opening in incognito if SSO weirdness persists.
sam_devex: if Datadog 403 persists after group add, run this quick check and paste results: ```curl -I -H "Cookie: $(cat ~/.okta_session 2>/dev/null)" "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/user"```
kai_chen: ran that, got 401 though. maybe my API key isn't set. i didn't generate one. i thought SSO web access would be enough for dashboards.
mira_platform: web SSO should be enough. 401 from the api call means no token — you don't need that for UI. can you try the UI again now?
kai_chen: UI still 403 on Sentry, Datadog UI just shows 'You do not have access to this dashboard'.
onboard-bot: Session sync complete for kai.chen@redwood.ai.
mira_platform: weird. I removed and re-added the group mapping for `obs-read`. can you try in 2-3 minutes and then reply here? also paste exact URL if it still 403s.
kai_chen: ok trying... the Sentry URL I'm hitting: https://sentry.redwood.ai/organizations/redwood/projects/runtime/errors/ — still 403.
sam_devex: hmm. can you open this helper — https://internal.redwood.ai/obs/access-check and paste the output (it prints effective groups)
kai_chen: output: `groups: engineers, developers` (no obs-read)
jordan_prodeng: @mira_platform looks like group mapping didn't attach to Kai's session yet. can you force a sync?
mira_platform: kicked a manual sync for Kai -> should be immediate. also sent a direct invite to the Sentry project as a stopgap.
onboard-bot: Manual sync requested by mira_platform for kai.chen@redwood.ai.
kai_chen: sync worked — access-check now shows `groups: engineers, developers, obs-read`. I can now open the Sentry project, thanks! :relieved:
kai_chen: small follow-up: I don't see the team-owned Grafana dashboards in the left nav — is there a shared folder or do I have to import?
sam_devex: Grafana uses team-level folders. check this URL for Runtime dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/runtime-overview. if it's missing, you might only have Viewer role. Ping `@mira_platform` to give `Editor` if you need to save/annotate.
kai_chen: i only need to view and pin. Viewer ok for now. thanks for the quick help everyone!
mira_platform: cool — leaving you as Viewer for now. if you need edit we can change. CC'ing docs: @jordan_prodeng to update onboarding note about forcing Okta sync if request button missing.
jordan_prodeng: good call, I'll add a troubleshooting note and the access-check link to the onboarding doc.
kai_chen: appreciate it — saved my morning. one last Q: is there a runbook for alert noise and who to ping for Runtime alert tuning?
sam_devex: yes, see /handbooks/observability/runbooks/alert-tuning.md. if an alert is firing repeatedly, tag `#alerts` and @runtime-oncall. we can triage.
kai_chen: perfect, bookmarking. thanks again!
